How do you achieve FI ? Simple: spend less than you earn. Over time, you will build up a nest egg. One simple graph explains this. No matter how much / little you earn what matters is your savings rate. (The multiple lines on the graph are estimated rates of return. Best to use the 3-5% lines.)
